Why the final step stays manual

KDP does not provide a public title-upload API. The tool prepares and checks the package, but you remain in control of account access, AI disclosure, Previewer approval, pricing, and publication.

Never give an automation tool your Amazon password. Review every Previewer warning before approving a book.
